Hi team,

Looping you in for a quick investigation. Customer ACME AI signed up via PLG self-serve and used promo ACME-REDWOOD-50. They have confirmation email but portal shows $0 credits. Samir is starting a POC and needs credits by EOD tomorrow.

What Im seeing in HubSpot: deal ACME-2026-PLG-01, created 2026-11-12.
Can someone check:
- Whether the coupon mapping service recorded the grant event
- If there was a failure in the issuance webhook to the billing service (SUP-6421)
- If timezone edge cases could cause the grant to be created with an expiry in the past (weve seen this once before)

If we cant confirm within 4 hours, please escalate to manual grant and Ill notify the customer. Attaching the screenshots the customer sent.

Thanks,
Monica

From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.inference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 16:09:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Promo code didn’t apply on signup - ACME demo org

Thanks for the ping. Quick postmortem: the issuance webhook succeeded on our side but the coupon metadata had an incorrect expiry timestamp after a daylight-savings timezone conversion (grant_time set in UTC-08:00, but expiry calculation used local offset incorrectly). Result: the credit was created with an expiry equal to the current time, so it never appeared as an active balance.

Remediation we applied:
- Manually issued $50 credit to billing@acmeai.com (grant id: GRANT-20261115-88XZ).
- Extended trial window by 7 days as a courtesy and updated the account notes.
- Filed a patch (PR #6421) to normalize expiry calculations and added unit tests for timezone handling.

Samir / Acme team: you should see the credit in the dashboard now. If anything still looks off I can trigger another manual grant (and we can do a short rollback if needed).

Attachments: internal debug log (redacted) attached.

—
Dev Patel
Payments & Integrations Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thread summary: Customer reported promo code not reflecting in self-serve dashboard. Sales triaged and escalated to payments engineering. Root cause: timezone/expiry bug in issuance flow. Resolution: manual $50 grant (GRANT-20261115-88XZ) and 7-day trial extension; fix committed to codebase (PR #6421). Customer notified.
